correctness.rationale: Existence and uniqueness follow from the stable linear convolution. Exact symbolic generator moment recursion reconstructs Cov(X²,V²)=-2u P_c/H, with H>0, and both marginal fourth cumulants. P_c has one positive root, beyond six, strictly increasing with u and with the stated asymptotics. Descartes sign analysis gives unique positive cumulant roots in the stated regimes, and explicit polynomial division yields strictly positive remainders with the signs needed for strict threshold ordering. The standalone checker reproduces all algebra and 168 rational substitutions; no finite sampling is used to prove universal signs.

value.rationale: The stationary energies of a persistently driven trapped inertial particle can switch between negative and positive covariance despite identically zero linear cross covariance. The exact threshold beyond stiffness six isolates a strongly underdamped region and its strict interlacing with marginal kurtosis sign boundaries yields a natural three-observable phase-space classification. The all-parameter structural theorem and positive-coefficient root ordering have direct bearing on interpreting stationary non-Gaussian energy fluctuations, without claiming dynamic or thermodynamic transitions.
